full_text_en:
Tang A v. Lianyungang Guangding Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Guannan County Kaiyuan Property Management Co., Ltd. — dispute over personal injury compensation

【Ruling Summary】

A property management company, as the administrator of community fitness equipment, shall conduct daily management and maintenance of such equipment. If the equipment has potential safety hazards, the property management company shall set up safety warning signs and promptly repair the equipment to ensure the safety of users. If the property management company fails to fulfill this duty and causes harm to others, it shall bear corresponding liability for compensation in accordance with the law.

Plaintiff: Tang A, female, 4 years old, residing in Guannan County, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Tang B (father of plaintiff Tang A), 43 years old, residing in Guannan County, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Lianyungang Guangding Real Estate Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Guannan County Economic Development Zone, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Guannan County Kaiyuan Property Management Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Xinxing North Road, Xin'an Town, Guannan County, Jiangsu Province.

The plaintiff, Tang A, filed a lawsuit with the Guannan County People's Court of Jiangsu Province against the defendants, Lianyungang Guangding Real Estate Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guangding Company) and Guannan County Kaiyuan Property Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Kaiyuan Company), concerning a dispute over personal injury compensation.

Plaintiff's Allegations: At approximately 4:00 p.m. on October 19, 2014, while the plaintiff was playing in the outdoor fitness area of the Nandayuan Community developed by the defendant Guangding Company, the left middle finger of the plaintiff was caught and crushed by the downward rotating pressing rod at the U-shaped connection at the top of the main pole of the abdominal and back exerciser, which was damaged. The injury was diagnosed as an open wound of the left middle finger with separation of the phalangeal epiphysis. The two defendants, as the owner and manager of the equipment, failed to fulfill their obligations of maintenance and safety management, causing the plaintiff to be injured inadvertently. The plaintiff requested that the court order the two defendants to jointly compensate the plaintiff for medical expenses, nursing expenses, hospital meal subsidies, nutritional expenses, and other costs, totaling RMB 19,045.06.

Defense of Guangding Company: Before the incident, Guangding Company had transferred the fitness equipment to Kaiyuan Company in accordance with the "Nandayuan Preliminary Property Service Contract" signed with the defendant Kaiyuan Company. At the time of transfer, the fitness equipment was not damaged, so Guangding Company should not bear liability for compensation.

Defense of Kaiyuan Company: The plaintiff, Tang A, is not an owner of the Nandayuan Community, and Kaiyuan Company has no obligation to provide management services to the plaintiff. The community has an independent children's play area. The fact that the plaintiff, a three-year-old child, was injured in the adult fitness area was due to the failure of the plaintiff's guardian to fulfill the duty of care, and has nothing to do with Kaiyuan Company. Kaiyuan Company requested that the court dismiss the plaintiff's claims.

The Guannan County People's Court found the following facts at first instance:

At approximately 4:00 p.m. on October 19, 2014, the plaintiff, Tang A, accompanied her mother, Zhou, to the Nandayuan Community in Guannan County. While Zhou was chatting with others by the outdoor fitness square in the community, the plaintiff entered the adult fitness area alone and played on the abdominal and back exerciser. During this time, the plaintiff's left middle finger was caught and crushed by a damaged abdominal and back exerciser. After the injury, the plaintiff was hospitalized at Huai'an First People's Hospital and Wuxi Ninth People's Hospital (Hand Surgery Hospital) for a total of 10 days, was diagnosed with an open wound of the left middle finger with separation of the phalangeal epiphysis, and incurred medical expenses of RMB 11,445.06.

On November 10, 2014, the Judicial Expertise Institute of Guannan County Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine conducted an assessment of the plaintiff's injuries: On the afternoon of October 19, 2014, Tang A's left middle finger was caught and crushed, resulting in the absence of the middle and distal phalanges of the left middle finger. The nutritional period was 60 days post-injury, and the nursing period was 90 days post-injury. The plaintiff paid RMB 600 for the appraisal fee.

Separately found: The Nandayuan Community was built by the defendant Guangding Company. On November 20, 2010, Guangding Company and the defendant Kaiyuan Company signed the "Nandayuan Preliminary Property Service Contract," which stipulated that Kaiyuan Company would provide preliminary property management services for the Nandayuan Community, including the daily operation and maintenance of shared property facilities and equipment. Subsequently, Guangding Company gradually transferred fitness venues, equipment, children's playgrounds, and other items to Kaiyuan Company. On November 7, 2013, Guangding Company and Kaiyuan Company signed the "Nandayuan Community Property Handover Inspection Record," which included 14 fitness equipment items, 2 fitness venues, 2 children's playground equipment items, and 1 children's playground venue, all confirmed to be in good condition and received by Kaiyuan Company.

Also found: The plaintiff, Tang A, and her guardian are not owners of the Nandayuan Community. Before the plaintiff was injured, the abdominal and back exerciser had been damaged for several days and had caused injury to another person. After the incident, the defendant Kaiyuan Company removed the damaged parts of the abdominal and back exerciser.

The Guannan County People's Court held at first instance:

Any person who infringes upon the rights of another person and causes physical injury shall bear liability for compensation. The plaintiff, Tang A, was injured by damaged fitness equipment in the Nandayuan Community. Although the defendant Guangding Company is the developer of the community, it had completed the handover and inspection procedures for the community's property facilities with the defendant Kaiyuan Company. Before the incident, the fitness equipment was intact and could be used normally, so Guangding Company had no fault regarding the plaintiff's injury and should not bear liability for compensation. As the property management enterprise of the Nandayuan Community, Kaiyuan Company has the obligation to maintain and manage the property facilities. It failed to inspect and repair the fitness equipment in a timely manner, resulting in certain safety hazards in the fitness equipment, which caused the plaintiff's fingers to be caught and crushed while playing. Kaiyuan Company is at fault for this. The plaintiff's request for Kaiyuan Company to bear liability for compensation is supported by the court. Zhou, the guardian, brought the three-year-old plaintiff to the Nandayuan Community and allowed the plaintiff to enter the fitness area alone, failing to fulfill her duty of care and bearing significant fault for the plaintiff's injury. Based on the degree of fault of the plaintiff's guardian Zhou and Kaiyuan Company, the court determined that Kaiyuan Company shall bear 30% of the liability for the plaintiff's injury. The plaintiff's losses due to the injury are as follows: medical expenses of RMB 11,445.06, nursing expenses of RMB 5,850 (RMB 65/day × 90 days), hospital meal subsidies of RMB 250 (RMB 25/day × 10 days), nutritional expenses of RMB 900 (RMB 15/day × 60 days), and appraisal fee of RMB 600, totaling RMB 19,045.06. Kaiyuan Company shall compensate RMB 5,713.52 (RMB 19,045.06 × 30%).

Accordingly, pursuant to Article 6, Article 16, and Article 26 of the Tort Liability Law of the PRC, and Article 17(1), Article 19, Article 21, Article 23, and Article 24 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Personal Injury Compensation, the Guannan County People's Court rendered the following judgment on March 19, 2015:

1. For the plaintiff, Tang A, who suffered losses of RMB 19,045.06 due to the injury, the defendant, Guannan County Kaiyuan Property Management Co., Ltd., shall compensate RMB 5,713.52, to be paid within ten days from the date this judgment becomes legally effective.

2. The other claims of the plaintiff, Tang A, are dismissed.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, neither party filed an appeal within the statutory time limit. The judgment of first instance has become legally effective.
